tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: Often derived from the Greek eleos, 'compassion', or from the Provençal name Aenor. Its root is Greek eleos / Provençal Aenor. A medieval Christian name borne by queens and saints. Eleanor is a Greek name meaning “Light; (also) the other Aenor”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
